messages:
nora.pm: thinking out loud — what if Console had adaptive saved-presets per route? idea: suggest 2-3 filter presets automatically based on recent queries & model usage, not forcing users to create them manually

alice.pm: like ML-assisted presets. interesting. what's the primary UX goal? reduce time-to-insight for newer routes? or declutter power-user saved queries?

camila.design: both. for new routes we surface a small ‘Suggested’ pillset above filters. for heavy routes, show 'Suggested for this model' and let users pin. keep it non-intrusive. visual mock in figma soon. :eyes:

ben.frontend: implementation Qs — how do we represent scope? per-route vs per-model vs global saved presets. do we add a scope enum to saved query objects?

dylan.backend: we'd want a lightweight object. proposal: `{"id":"uuid","name":"Suggested — last 7d","scope":"route|model|org","filters":[...],"generated":true}`. generated presets don't count against user saved-query quotas unless pinned.

erin.data: telemetry names for this: `console.suggested_preset.shown`, `console.suggested_preset.pinned`, `console.suggested_preset.dismissed`, `console.suggested_preset.used`. Also log `source: 'query-agg'` or `source: 'kv-cache'` for origin. keep privacy in mind — no token-level data.

alice.pm: what rules drive suggestion? frequency, recency, error rate?

dylan.backend: start simple: top-n filter combos by count and avg latency from the last 7 days, exclude combos with < 5 hits. second pass: prefer combos that reduce tokens (prefix hits) or that correlate with cache hits.

ben.frontend: UI flow: small banner on first encounter: "Suggested filters for this route — try 1 of 3" -> then tray with pills. if user pins, we convert generated->user_saved and increment quota usage. need an undo.

camila.design: add tiny tooltip copy: "Suggestions learned from recent usage on this route and model". if privacy toggle off, hide suggestions.

erin.data: also recommend recording a hashed fingerprint for filter combos so we can rollup without storing raw param values. store counts, avg latency, success rate. event payload minimal: `{preset_hash, route_id, model_id, count, avg_latency_ms}`.

nora.pm: questions about ownership + sharing: if a generated preset is pinned by user A in org X, should other users in org see it? my take: respect the scope selected at pin time — default to org visible for owners with org perms, otherwise private.

dylan.backend: auth-wise simple: pinned presets create a normal saved_query row with owner_id and scope field. generated items are ephemeral in cache with TTL 24h, recomputed every 6h.

ben.frontend: edge cases — route with multiple models routed by policy. which model_id do we show? show 'model cluster' or fall back to route-level aggregate. maybe show badge: "Suggested based on model A (80%) + model B (20%)"

camila.design: that badge sounds good. small heatbar would be neat but avoid clutter.

erin.data: telemetry to capture model mix: `preset.model_mix = [{model_id, pct}]` but keep sample sizes modest. we can truncate list to top 3.

alice.pm: rollout plan? prefer a canary: 5% of orgs, metrics: pin rate, use rate, dismiss rate, effect on query execution (latency change), and support tickets.

nora.pm: agree. we should also add an experiment flag so we can A/B different suggestion heuristics (7d vs 14d, min_count 5 vs 10).

dylan.backend: will add config: `suggested_presets.enabled`, `min_count`, `lookback_days`, `ttl_hours`. default: enabled=false for now.

ben.frontend: needs API endpoint: `GET /api/v1/routes/:id/suggested-presets` returns list of {id?, name, filters, model_mix, confidence_score}. mark `generated: true` for client. caching at CDN level ok.

erin.data: we'll add nightly job to compute candidate presets and a quick realtime aggregator for last-hour spikes. realtime only for surfacing, canonicalization from nightly job.

camila.design: accessibility note — don't hide important filter controls behind suggestions; must be additive.

nora.pm: decision checklist: 1) represent generated presets separately, 2) do not count against quota until pinned, 3) compute by top-n combos, 4) add telemetry events -> agreed?

alice.pm: agreed from PM side.

dylan.backend: backend OK, will sketch API and DB changes tomorrow.

ben.frontend: I'll prototype UI this week, flagging potential perf hits if we fetch on every route page load — will gate with `?suggestions=true` in initial canary.

erin.data: I'll produce telemetry spec doc and hashed payload examples.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: none — feature gated, no infra changes needed for canary. :robot_face:

nora.pm: awesome. follow-ups: design mock, API contract, telemetry spec. tagging owners: @camila.design, @ben.frontend, @dylan.backend, @erin.data. thanks all! :tada:
